description: Demurrage and detention risk report: which containers are near or past their free days, the daily rates, and the projected cost. Call this when asked about demurrage risk or detention fees. Free days are resolved per shipment from the customer's own contract terms first, then the carrier's published tariff, then a cross-carrier benchmark — `terms_source` and `confidence` on each item say which was used, so an estimated tariff figure must be reported as estimated, not as their contract. Read the counters before drawing a conclusion: `unassessable_containers` are boxes whose free time could not be resolved at all (an empty item list alongside a non-zero count means "cannot assess", NEVER "no risk"), `uncosted_containers` are at risk with no daily rate on file (so `total_at_risk_usd` is a floor, not the exposure), and `truncated: true` means the fleet is larger than the report. Pass container_id to assess a single shipment: `scope_container.verdict` is one of at_risk / within_free_time / not_discharged / no_terms / no_destination / not_demurrage_eligible.

container_id.description: Optional: scope to a single container ID. Omit for portfolio-wide report.
